en.headline: Paul Chan departs for AIIB annual meeting in Qatar
en.dek: The Financial Secretary will deliver a keynote on digital public infrastructure and meet fellow governors and business leaders under the theme of tomorrow's infrastructure.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan will depart for Qatar late on Saturday to attend the 11th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank in Doha.

The meeting, themed "Tomorrow's Infrastructure: Impact and Innovation", will bring together government officials, multilateral development institutions and business leaders to discuss sustainable infrastructure, cross-border connectivity, green finance and digital transformation.

Chan will attend the official Board of Governors meeting and deliver a keynote speech at a thematic session on digital public infrastructure. He will also hold bilateral meetings with other AIIB governors and local and international political and business leaders.
He is scheduled to return to Hong Kong on the afternoon of 29 September. During his absence, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong will act as Financial Secretary.

zh.headline: 陳茂波深夜啟程赴卡塔爾出席亞投行年會
zh.dek: 財政司司長將在多哈亞投行第十一屆理事會年會發表數字公共基建主旨演講，並與其他理事及政商界領袖會面。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波將於周六深夜啟程前往卡塔爾，出席在多哈舉行的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行第十一屆理事會年會。
年會以「明日基建：影響與創新」為主題，匯聚各地政府官員、多邊發展機構及商界領袖，就可持續基建、跨境互聯互通、綠色融資及數字轉型等議題交流。
陳茂波會出席理事會正式會議，並在有關數字公共基建的專題環節發表主旨演講，亦會與其他亞投行理事及當地和國際政商界領袖會面。
他將於9月29日下午返港。離港期間，財政司副司長黃偉綸將署任財政司司長。
